processing.modification: Starward selected 51 Messier galaxy/nebula targets and published three north-up ICRS TAN JPEG cutouts per target through CDS hips2fits, with 1-99.7 percentile asinh grayscale stretch; these are processed 12 micrometer survey images, not visible-light photographs.
limitations: Historical 12 micrometer survey imagery; it is neither naked-eye appearance nor realtime sky data.
Source-survey saturation and detector artifacts may remain after bounded stretch and resampling.
